name: font-size-adjust
description: The font-size-adjust CSS property adjusts the size of a font to match a chosen font metric, such as the height of lowercase letters, to a specified proportion of the "font-size". This property is intended for adjusting fallback fonts to have similar metrics as the first-choice font.
syntax: none | [ ex-height | cap-height | ch-width | ic-width | ic-height ]? [ from-font | <number [0,∞]> ]
